# Fim

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs generate` from `schemas/events/v1.json`. Do not edit by hand. -->

A change to a monitored file (#183). The file as it is now is
[`super::Event::file`]; this records what it was before.

Appears at: `/fim`.

| `old_sha256` | string | no |  | matches `^[0-9a-f]{64}$` | 1.1.0 | SHA-256 of the content before. |
